notes: Read-only production snapshot; no prompts, credentials, image data or storage URLs exported.
Success duration_ms is adapter request wall time, including networking and response parsing; upstream queue/inference/transfer cannot be separated.
Attempts with RESOURCE_WAIT are publication deferrals, not necessarily provider retries.
Task elapsed uses task creation and first attempt start, not execution.started_at which is overwritten on later claims.
Detailed normal timing selects successful tasks with exactly one successful provider call.
